messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Pager: dedicated-resv-3 pool report: GPU utilization 100%, queued requests 18k, avg latency 750ms (> SLO). Impacting reserved tenants: AureliaCorp (high), several best-effort jobs throttled. Autoscaler attempted +4 nodes but hit external quota API 429.
Mike H: acked. jumping in. can someone paste the top offending pods/jobs?
Sarah G: +1. CS pinged — AureliaCorp is seeing failed requests and increased retries. they reported errors ~5m ago.
Jin Lee: running quick top of queue and pods now.
Jin Lee: ```
# metrics snapshot
gpu_utilization{pool="dedicated-resv-3"} 1.0
queued_requests{pool="dedicated-resv-3"} 18123
pod{job="aurelia-batch-1"} gpu=1 runtime=>72h cpu=2
pod{job="analytics-sandbox-7"} gpu=2 runtime=>36h
```
Jin Lee: looks like a long-running analytics sandbox (non-reserved) and a large AureliaCorp streaming job filling KV caches. eviction policy not firing because these are "pinned-resv" jobs for AureliaCorp.
Priya Rao: AureliaCorp has reserved capacity but also a burst job that exceeded their reserved delta, started consuming shared pool. We hit shared-reserve->dedicated overflow. autoscaler couldn't self-heal due to API rate limit to cloud provider (429 when creating instances).
Prod Eng: we should throttle non-SLA traffic and evict noisy best-effort tenants. Can we pause or scale down analytics-sandbox-7?
Mike H: I can kill/suspend analytics-sandbox-7; it's non-reserved. doing a graceful drain now.
Mike H: `kubectl scale deployment analytics-sandbox-7 --replicas=0 -n dev-sandboxes`
Mike H: done. checking pool usage...
Jin Lee: after drain: queued_requests -> 12450, gpu_utilization 96%, latency 620ms. improvement but still bad.
Oncall Pager: handing off to next oncall (Sarah G) for remediation and customer comms. @Sarah G you're up.
Sarah G: taking over. priority: stop tail latency for AureliaCorp, communicate upstream. Jin, can you identify long-tail requests for AureliaCorp?
Jin Lee: yes, streaming workers are pinning KV cache causing memory pressure and stall. One large job id=job-9845 has been retrying. logs: ```
ERROR ServeLoop: write timeout after 120s, retrying
```
Priya Rao: immediate mitigation options: 1) force-evict job-9845 (AureliaCorp agreed to permit emergency throttles in contract?), 2) temporarily increase dedicated-resv-3 by using spare capacity from other zones (we have quota but autoscaler rate limit was transient), 3) fallback AureliaCorp traffic to hosted-api with degraded throughput.
Sarah G: check contract. Support Bot, any note about emergency throttles for AureliaCorp?
Support Bot: AureliaCorp contract clause 4.2 allows emergency throttling with notice via support@aurelia. Drafting message now.
Mike H: I recommend 1 + 2 simultaneously: evict the long-running non-critical AureliaCorp job (they have a streaming task that can be resumed) and trigger manual instance creations bypassing autoscaler (temp escalation to cloud ops). I'll request manual capacity from cloud team.
Prod Eng: note: manual instance creation still hit the same 429 once per second. recommendation: stagger requests and use different service account token; also open a support ticket with cloud provider.
Jin Lee: evicting job-9845 now (grace 30s): `redwoodctl jobs abort job-9845 --force --reason "emergency eviction - pool saturation"`
Mike H: abort returned 200. job terminated. GPU allocation freed. checking metrics...
Jin Lee: queued_requests -> 4200, gpu_utilization 72%, latency 210ms. major improvement.
Sarah G: great. but we still want autoscaler fix and to ensure customers aren't impacted. actions: 1) raise cloud provider support ticket for rate-limited API calls (Priya), 2) post incident note to AureliaCorp and offer SRE call (Support Bot), 3) patch autoscaler to exponential backoff and token rotation (Prod Eng), 4) add a safeguard to prevent single reserved tenant bursts from consuming shared pool (Mike).
Priya Rao: opened support ticket #CP-112233 with latency logs and 429 traces. asked for quota review and guidance on best practices.
Support Bot: sent notification draft to AureliaCorp and flagged priority. awaiting approval from Sarah.
Sarah G: approve and send. also scheduling follow-up postmortem for 08:00 UTC tomorrow. Mike, Jin, Priya, Prod Eng please join.
Mike H: will do.
Jin Lee: I'll collect heapdumps and KV cache metrics for the pod, and capture request traces for job-9845.
Prod Eng: I'll work on autoscaler backoff patch; putting a temp rule to limit per-tenant burst consumption to 20% of shared pool.
Sarah G: thanks team. post-incident follow-ups assigned. leaving note: we restored within ~12m from first page. customer impact: degraded performance & errors for some AureliaCorp requests during that window; support notified. closing handoff. :white_check_mark:
Incident Bot: Incident closed? manual close pending postmortem artifact creation.
Support Bot: Postmortem ticket created: INC-2530001122-pool-saturation-pm.
